designationHistory.indexText: Congress created the Dwight D. Eisenhower Memorial Commission to plan a permanent memorial to Eisenhower, in the defense appropriations act for 2000.

authority.citation: Public Law 106-79, title VIII, sec. 8162, 113 Stat. 1274

designationHistory.note: An NPS brochure text (NPS History Collection) says the commission was established by Congress in 2000; the law was signed Oct. 25, 1999, as part of fiscal year 2000 appropriations.

sources.name: 40 U.S.C. 8903 notes (Cornell LII), 'Dwight D. Eisenhower Memorial'

designationHistory.indexText: The Dwight D. Eisenhower Memorial was dedicated and the National Park Service took over its operation from the memorial commission.

authority.citation: Dedication and handover to the National Park Service, Sept. 17, 2020

sources.name: Eisenhower Memorial Commission news release on the dedication (PR Newswire)
NPS History Collection, Dwight D. Eisenhower Memorial (establishment Sept. 17, 2020)
